newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Mary El likely to drop Eurobond plans.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Mary El likely to drop Eurobond plans.

text.p: Russia's Mary El republic is likely to drop plans to issue a Eurobond, as it could face problems with repayment, a local Finance Ministry official said on Tuesday.
"Most probably we shall not issue a Eurobond," head of market structures department Irina Mukhamedazizova told Reuters. "We shall not be able to guarantee the issue."
Last month a federal Finance Ministry official said Mary El was planning a Eurobond.
But Mukhamedazizova said the decision to issue a Eurobond was taken by the republic's former authorities. New leaders, who came in after elections in January, did not favour the idea.
Mukhamedazizova said the final decision would be taken in a month or six weeks.
